colony.name: Colony
colony.description: Settle a habitable world. Colonies pay taxes, do some research and can host colony buildings (shipyard, trade hub, defenses).

mining_base.name: Mining Base
mining_base.description: Automated mines on a rocky world or asteroid belt.

research_station.name: Research Station
research_station.description: A sealed science base on an ice moon, gas giant or barren rock.

gas_refinery.name: Gas Refinery
gas_refinery.description: Skims fuel from a gas giant's upper atmosphere and sells it.

trade_hub.name: Trade Hub
trade_hub.description: Markets and docks. Needs a colony.

defense_platform.name: Defense Platform
defense_platform.description: Orbital gun platform. Fights any enemy that attacks the system. Needs a colony.
